Sarah thought she was being a culinary rebel. She wanted her cookies to have a little "kick," so she reached for the chili powder. But in her haste, she confused the sugar bowl with the salt shaker. The result? A batch of "sweet and salty surprise" cookies that tasted like someone had melted a bag of Skittles into a handful of pretzels. Her friends didn't just eat them; they performed a synchronized dance with their milk glasses, chugging dairy in a desperate attempt to wash away the confusing flavor profile. It wasn't a baking disaster; it was a flavor experiment that left everyone questioning their life choices.
